collection-heading.purpose: Compact current collection/category heading beside search, using relative type and strong weight.

page-title.purpose: Strong relative heading on support surfaces; page-title-mobile applies at widths up to 720px.

article-title.purpose: Established desktop article title with strong weight; Chinese headings remove tracking.

article-title-focus.purpose: Focused article title at the established larger size with strong weight.

article-section.purpose: Explicit h2 inside saved body text, with the relative section scale and strong weight.

collection-title.purpose: Native original-link title shared by collection cards and list rows; list view preserves the strong title scale.

index-title.purpose: The smaller strong title role in the supporting index opened only by explicit Preview.

collection-summary.purpose: Readable summary or page excerpt with 1.75 leading, up to four lines before explicit expansion; source provenance remains visible.

index-summary.purpose: The same readable summary role in the optional preview index, with a three-line clamp.

body.purpose: Relative root body role for search input, form values and shared body text.

reading.purpose: Relative saved prose: desktop 1.125rem, mobile 1.0625rem, with 1.85 leading.

button.purpose: Routine primary/secondary actions using the UI role at weight 600.

search.purpose: Body-sized search text at every breakpoint.

tab.purpose: Reader and Settings tabs using the UI role and weight 600, including mobile.

label.purpose: Form labels using the UI role and weight 600.

caption.purpose: Relative auxiliary text and category counts.

workspace-heading.purpose: The same compact heading scale with an article selected.

outline.purpose: Wrapping labels for actual article headings.

meta.purpose: Relative source, date, active-filter and collection metadata.

list-summary.purpose: Multiline summary or page excerpt in list view, retained on mobile with the same readable size and leading.

article-subsection.purpose: Explicit h3 inside saved reading content, stronger and larger than body text.

category-label.purpose: Readable deep-ink category names at rest.

category-selected.purpose: Selected category names with strong weight and lake-blue state.

form-input.purpose: Form values and inherited-size placeholders, using body size with regular weight.

navigation-active.purpose: Active header navigation with stronger weight than inactive labels.

reader-return.purpose: Explicit return label in desktop and narrow preview.

page-title-mobile.purpose: Relative support-page heading at widths up to 720px, retaining the desktop weight.

support-copy.purpose: Readable secondary-ink explanations for support sections, model purposes, task operations and import help or results.

category-parent.purpose: Muted parent folder path above the leaf name; preserve the full path in the accessible label and native title.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Empty collection and other active utility toggles; ordinary cards are flat, and Tasks/Settings use selected fill without a shadow.

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark empty collection and other active utility toggles; Tasks/Settings use selected fill without a shadow.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Desktop reader; support pages remain flat.

shadows.name: sheet-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark desktop reader; support pages remain flat.

shadows.name: navigation
shadows.purpose: Open drawer only; closed drawer has no shadow.

motion.name: css-ease

motion.name: cards-and-segments
motion.purpose: Primary/secondary colors and borders; card border; header/folder/disclosure states. Original-link icons stay visible.

motion.name: tab-marker

motion.name: focus-pane
motion.purpose: Interruptible GSAP x/y translation, cleared on completion.

motion.name: modal-reader

motion.name: progress
motion.purpose: Motion scaleX from measured saved-body scroll; direct value with reduced motion.

motion.name: busy

motion.name: suggestions-and-outline

components.name: Reader header, tabs and outline
components.description: Secondary preview retains a separate return/action header, independent tabs and an outline of real headings. Desktop uses a 56px header and 48px tab row; narrow preview retains modal return controls and focus handling.
components.html: 文章目录

narrative.overview:
Facetmark is a compact, readable workspace for returning to saved pages. Pure white
surfaces, deep blue ink and restrained lake-blue state keep content and actions
clear. The layered mark and offline typography preserve a recognizable identity
across desktop and Web.

The system favors unboxed navigation, plain support sections, nearby labels and
feedback, and bounded temporary overlays. Collection cards retain their content
grouping; preview retains its reading measure. Refine the whole workflow within
this identity rather than introducing a new visual world for each screen.
keyCharacteristics: Strong collection titles and readable descriptions in both card and list views.
Restrained shared controls, circular icon actions and unboxed navigation.
Plain full-width support sections with adjacent fields, actions and feedback.
Lake-blue emphasis for selection, focus and the next explicit action.
Content-driven height, responsive fields and independent interaction targets.
State and recovery expressed with truthful text as well as color.

rules.name: The Lake-blue Selection Rule
rules.body: Use lake blue to identify selection, focus and explicit actions; keep ordinary original-link titles legible in deep ink and reserve danger color for failures and destructive actions.

rules.name: The Shared Reading Scale Rule
rules.body: Switching card/list view must preserve title size and weight. Keep descriptions visible on mobile and use actual clipping to decide when expansion is needed.

rules.name: The Bounded Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep the workbench and support sections flat. Use elevation for an overlay or reading sheet that needs separation from its context.

rules.name: The Restrained Control Rule
rules.body: Use the shared control radius for routine actions and fields. Preserve card, reader, icon and popover exceptions deliberately; do not wrap every navigation group or support section in another rounded panel.

dos: Do preserve readable card/list titles, visible descriptions and local Chinese weight differences.
Do use the shared 7px control radius while preserving scoped card, reader and circle exceptions.
Do keep navigation unboxed and support settings in full-width sections.
Do place model choice, test/save and actionable feedback together.
Do distinguish model discovery, selection, successful testing, saving and actual use.
Do keep display preferences separate from processing scope and consent.
Do preserve independent original links, checkboxes, editing and optional preview.
Do place exact task scope and recovery before new-work shortcuts.
Do preserve keyboard access, focus return, responsive layouts and reduced motion.
donts: Don't restore the rejected grey-violet palette, oversized masthead or permanent three-column management shell.
Don't restore single-line summaries, hidden mobile excerpts or automatic reader entry on title activation.
Don't turn navigation or every support section into another rounded container.
Don't bury model selection under advanced settings or label a returned catalog as verified access.
Don't claim a configuration was saved when only its test succeeded.
Don't broaden a task-specific retry to unrelated failed bookmarks.
Don't invent headings, progress, successful task states or user aesthetic approval.
Don't let CSS, GSAP and Motion animate the same property on the same element.
